name: DR Congo (east)
value: Kivu clashes; no city changed hands
summary: M23-led alliance and pro-government forces clash in the Kivus; no city changes hands
state: Clashes continued in late October in Walikale, Rutshuru, Minembwe and the Walungu highlands with no operationally significant change on the ground (Critical Threats, 28 Oct). Peace talks under an August roadmap remain stalled. Ebola and cholera outbreaks add to the strain in the east. No major city had changed hands as of 4 Nov.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to eastern DR Congo. Aid appeals are the main route for public support.
rubric_hit: Active fighting without capture of a major city = Watch

sources.title: Critical Threats — Congo War Security Review, 28 Oct
Al Jazeera — DR Congo, M23 agree roadmap for peace talks

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.

rubric.alert: Capture of a major city, or direct interstate fighting.
rubric.watch: Active fighting or a fragile ceasefire.
rubric.normal: Peace agreements holding; no major offensives.
